name: consec_air_carry_pays_phi_of_the_chain_credit_then_refunds_on_landing
description: The car flies level at 1500 uu/s (z 900) into the floating ball and PUSHES it: a push registers a touch on every step of the contact in the engine (frames 8 to 25, 18 steps). Each touch now adds the ball-height credit (z - 150)/1300 to the effective streak e; the ball sinks from z 806 to about 120 while carried, so the credits shrink (0.5051, 0.4856, 0.4639, ... down to 0): e = 0.51 (frame 8), 0.99 (frame 9, still under 1 so nothing yet), 1.45 (frame 10), 1.89, 2.31, 2.69, 3.05 ... saturating at 4.51 by frame 24. Pay: frame 10 gamma*Phi(1.4546) = 0.9969*(1 - exp(-0.2273)) = 0.20268 (+8.1 at weight 40); cumulative 0.4768 by frame 12, 0.796 by frame 20, peak +0.8004 (+32.0 weighted, under the old +38.7 because the ball is not at full height). While the chain is held it bleeds (gamma-1)*Phi per step. The car lands on frame 29 and the whole chain is refunded; the run nets the bleed only, -0.04177 (-1.67 weighted). The ball starts with a 1 uu/s upward velocity on purpose (a ball set with exactly zero velocity in the air floats: see tools/reward_lab/README.md). Verified independently: a separate script that recomputes the effective streak from the exported on-ground, touched and ball-height values reproduces every step's reward to 1e-7.

expect.intent: the car keeps touching the ball from frame 8 to 25
through frame 9 the effective streak is 0.99, still under 1: nothing is paid
x40 = +8.1 for the first paying touch
landing refunds the whole chain: the run nets only the holding bleed, -0.04177
